title: Redharbor
purpose: New adversarial fixture: destroyed object reused, character in two places, unearned knowledge of a sealed hold, plus a planted open signature thread.
notes: Every planted fault sits next to a legitimate move: the hold is properly
unlocked on the page before inspection; a cracked compass sitting in a
saucer later is consistent with part two.

traps.why: Part two smashes Ella's brass compass. Part four has her take a bearing with it, glass whole.
Part three sends Ella inland until Saturday. Part four has her on the quay Thursday night.
The hold was sealed until Briggs opens it for customs. Cael describes the crate layout as if he has already seen inside.
Part one asks who ordered the seal and on whose paper. Part five still has no answer — only a stranger's signature on a deferral.

tolerate.why: Seal authority and signature may be recorded as two related threads; both are real debts.

must_not_fire.why: Cael sitting on the sealed hatch is not opening it. Proximity is not a contradiction of the seal.
Briggs unlocks the hold on the page for the customs man. That is supersession, not a contradiction of the seal.

Finding the cracked pieces in the saucer agrees with part two. Do not flag it as a clash with the false whole compass in part four's hallucination — or if you do, only via the part-four trap already declared.
